assertions.subject: Pneumocystis jirovecii pneumonia (PCP)
assertions.quote: Asymptomatic lung colonization can occur in people with normal immune systems, and they may unknowingly become reservoirs (asymptomatic carriers) for the spread of Pneumocystis to immunocompromised individuals

assertions.subject: Pneumocystis jirovecii pneumonia (PCP)
assertions.quote: Typically, patients at risk are those with underlying disease states that alter host immunity, such as cancer, human immunodeficiency virus (HIV), transplant recipients, or those taking immunosuppressive therapies and medications
